visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a smartphone screen displaying a keyboard with a customized photographic background. A user's thumb is seen tapping the screen repeatedly. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A medium shot reveals a young woman with long, vibrant reddish-pink hair smiling broadly at the camera. She is holding her phone to show the screen. She is dressed in a light grey knit top, and the background shows a typical office setting with computer monitors and stationery. (3) The scene transitions to a high-definition screen recording of the iOS App Store. A finger interacts with the interface to search for and download the Gboard application. The background is white and clean. (4) The recording continues inside the Gboard app settings. The user navigates through 'Theme' and 'Custom' options. A photo gallery opens, and a finger scrolls through various selfies before selecting a specific photo featuring two girls. (5) An editing interface appears where the selected photo is cropped. The user adjusts sliders for 'Brightness' and selects a light blue color from a palette of colored dots to customize the keyboard's key appearance. (6) In a new scene, the woman is in an indoor restroom with pink tiled walls. She approaches a friend wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and shows her the phone screen. Both women exhibit expressive, joyful facial reactions and laughter. (7) The final shot is a close-up of the completed keyboard on the smartphone screen, showcasing the vibrant custom photo and blue key highlights.
